scope: XGCreateTextureComputer (ordinal 11) with default layout 0 for a bounded subset. Identical guest and XMem dependency; complete layouts and sampled element addresses compared against the supplied Xbox XG DLL.
subset: 57 color formats covering 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 byte elements; five square and rectangular shapes from 4x4 through 1024x1024 including the Frosty 1024x1024 descriptor; one mip and slice, one sample, layout 0, flags 0xc00001 or 0xc00005, zero alignment and quality. Other combinations are unsupported.
